data.name: Araldo
data.gender_notes: Araldo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Araldo is a name of Latin origin, derived from the elements 'ar' meaning eagle and 'aldus' meaning ruler or powerful. In Christian contexts, this name is reminiscent of the eagle as a symbol of strength, courage, and wisdom, as seen in the Bible's imagery of eagles soaring in the heavens. The name Araldo carries the meaning “Ruler of the eagle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Araldo usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the eagle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Araldo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the eagle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Araldo total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אראלדו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אראלדו מקורו בשם הגרמני 'ארלד', שפירושו 'שליט צבא' או 'אדון צבא'. השם מורכב מ'אר' שפירושו 'צבא' ו'וולד' שפירושו 'שליט' או 'אדון'. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם אראלדו מייצג כוח, אומץ ומנהיגות.

in_greek.name: Αράλδο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αράλδο προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Erlald', που σημαίνει 'κυβερνήτης του στρατού' ή 'άρχοντας του στρατού'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από το 'er' που σημαίνει 'στρατός' και το 'wald' που σημαίνει 'κυβερνήτης' ή 'άρχοντας'. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Αράλδο αντιπροσωπεύει δύναμη, θάρρος και ηγεσία.

in_latin.name: Araldo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Araldo originem habet in nomine germanico 'Erlald', quod significat 'dux exercitus' vel 'princeps exercitus'. Nomen constat ex 'er' quod significat 'exercitus' et 'wald' quod significat 'dux' vel 'princeps'. In contextu christiano, nomen Araldo repraesentat fortitudinem, audaciam et ductum.

in_english.name: Araldo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Araldo originates from the Germanic name 'Erlald', which means 'army ruler' or 'commander of the army'. It is composed of 'er' meaning 'army' and 'wald' meaning 'ruler' or 'commander'. In Christian tradition, the name Araldo signifies strength, courage, and leadership. It is associated with qualities of bravery, confidence, and strategic thinking.

In the Christian context, this name comes with additional biblical significance, as eagles are often used as symbols of the Power and Sovereignty of God.

The name Araldo serves as a constant reminder of the eagle's majestic qualities and the Christian's aspiration to embody them in their lives.
